title: Ansem's Dialogue - Kingdom Hearts 0: Door to Darkness
note: Every line in the game is Ansem's voice. He narrates the story, taunts the Shamblers, and - in the last act - lets the truth about Zero's past slip, one word at a time.
prologue: Listen. And listen well, for what I am about to tell you was never written in any book of the worlds.
There is a keyblade wielder the worlds do not name. They call him Zero - the unknown.
He walks the edges of every story. He is the bridge between light and dark.
Now the Door to Darkness is opening. The heroes are scattered across a thousand worlds. And the unknown must step out of the shadows at last.

veska_the_erasure: Veska erases what it does not understand. You are fortunate, Zero - it has never understood you.
It is already forgetting your name. Do not let it forget your blade.
throx_the_echo: The Echo copies everything it hears. Careful, Zero - it has heard your heart beating since Destiny Islands.
Every strike you make, it makes better. Fight like yourself, not like your echo.
qilra_the_trial: The Trial judges memory itself. It has already struck your journal from the record. What remains of your story now?
Off with your name. That is its only sentence - and it never appeals.
herrak_the_phantom: The Phantom fights in the bracket Hades built for ghosts. Win, and even Hades will have to remember you.
It steals drive gauges, Zero. It knows what you will need to become.
zankor_the_vine: The Vine speaks in borrowed words. Even its threats belong to someone else.
It strangles the jungle's voice so the Keyhole cannot cry for help.
mallos_the_hoard: The Hoard weighs its memories in gold. It has been weighing yours for a thousand years.
A diamond in the rough glitters only in the dark. It is afraid you will glitter brighter than its treasure.
vurok_the_belly: Vurok swallows commands like sailors. Its hunger is the only memory it keeps.
Empty it, Zero. That is the only mercy it understands.
yssora_the_tide: The Tide stole a princess's voice because it could not stand one thing that was purely sweet.
Under the sea, even silence has a song. It is terrified you will sing.
grinx_the_grin: The Grin is a smile with nothing behind it. You know that smile, Zero - you have worn it for years.
It steals time because it is running out of it.
nox_the_hook: The Hook steals the memory of flight so everyone must walk its plank. How does a cloak learn to hate the sky?
It fears falling. Everything Shambler fears falling - the dark below them is the same dark they feed on.
poohs_shadow: The Page-Eater is what a Shambler becomes when it tries to eat a world made of kindness. It chokes, Zero. It chokes and cannot stop.
That world is the only one that has never held a keyhole. It eats Shamblers for breakfast.
the_machine_heart: This is the heart of the machine that made me. Beating it is beating the narrator of your own story.
It wears my memory like armor. Everything I have said to you - it has heard it all.
the_hinge_that_opens: The Hinge only opens what should stay shut. It creaks the old name of the door it serves, and the name is not mine.
Do not let it finish its sentence, Zero. You are not ready to hear it.
the_organizations_eye: The Eye watches every battle and sells the knowledge. It has already sold your story to the Archon.
It sees everything except the one thing you have always kept hidden. Use that.
saix_the_berserker: Saix's face is only a mask now. The berserk moon behind it is pure Shambler - and the moon is full tonight.
The longer it fights, the less of itself it remembers being. Be glad your own madness has a name.
luxord_the_gambler: Luxord deals from your memories. Every card is a day you lived that it thinks it can spend.
It bets everything on the last hand. Win, and it will owe you more than it can steal.
the_archon: The Archon stole the Door to Darkness itself. It has worn the door's weight ever since - and the weight has made it strong.
It stands in every world you ever visited, all at once. Only the Twilight Form's five keyblades can reach all of it.
Fight it as yourself, Zero. Fight it as the one who lived between. And when it asks your name - remember that it already stole it.
This is the last story I will narrate. I am proud of the one telling it.

keyhole_closed: The keyhole closes. Another world breathes.
Sealed. The door between that world and the dark has been locked from the inside.
The keyhole remembers the one who closed it. You are becoming real to the worlds, Zero.
shambler_defeated: A Shambler falls - and with it, a fragment of the memory it stole.
The cloak collapses into nothing. Somewhere, a stolen memory returns to its owner.
You have unwritten one of the Archon's pages.
archon_defeated: It is done. The Archon falls, and the Door to Darkness closes at last - from both sides.
You were never alone in there, were you, Terra?
The old name slips out. I could not keep it forever. The story is over, Zero - and now the story of who you were can begin.

journal_entries.traverse_town: The urchins named me Zero. I let them. It is easier than the truth.
journal_entries.destiny_islands: I saw the drawing in the cave. A keyblade, drawn by children who did not know what they were drawing. I took a shard of the first light.
journal_entries.wonderland: The Queen judged me without a trial. I judged her without a verdict. We were both wrong, but I closed the keyhole first.
journal_entries.olympus_coliseum: Hercules never saw me fight. He saw a shadow win. That is what I am for.
journal_entries.deep_jungle: I spoke without the mask today. The jungle accepted me anyway. I have forgotten the last time that happened.
journal_entries.agrabah: I left a single coin in the Cave of Wonders. The only treasure I have ever owned.
journal_entries.monstro: The whale sneezed us free. Pinocchio's heart was real - made, but real. I held it for a moment.
journal_entries.atlantica: I tasted salt today. I did not know I could taste anything.
journal_entries.halloween_town: Jack took his bow. I closed the grin before it could laugh at us.
journal_entries.neverland: I found proof Sora is alive. The boy who lost himself is still out there.
journal_entries.hundred_acre_wood: For one chapter, I was not the unknown. I was just someone who walked in from the dark to play. It was the best chapter.
journal_entries.hollow_bastion: I saw a face in the reflection that was not mine. Old eyes. A seeker's eyes. The dark whispered a name I have never spoken: Terra.
journal_entries.pride_lands: The Hinge creaked the old name again. I covered my ears, but the sound was inside my head.
journal_entries.land_of_dragons: The Eye sold my story. I wonder what it was worth.
journal_entries.disney_castle: The clockwork vault held a fragment of the final keyblade. The Archon knows I am coming.
journal_entries.port_royal: I won the last hand. Luxord owes me more than it can steal - it owes me its name.
journal_entries.wnwas: The Archon stole the Door itself. I am going to take it back.
